description: This file defines the Perl module Mail::Address, which provides functionality to parse and manipulate email address strings, including extracting names, hosts, and user parts, as well as formatting addresses.

classes.name: Mail::Address
classes.description: A class that represents an email address with methods to parse, format, and extract components such as name, host, and user from email address strings.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Returns the version of the Mail::Address module.

methods.name: _extract_name
methods.description: Attempts to extract a person's name from a comment or phrase.

methods.name: _tokenise
methods.description: Tokenizes a string into meaningful components such as comments, addresses, and symbols.

methods.name: _find_next
methods.description: Finds the next separator token in a token array.

methods.name: _complete
methods.description: Constructs a new Mail::Address object from phrase, address, and comment arrays.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructs a new Mail::Address object with given components.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a string or list of strings into a Mail::Address object, handling comments and address parts.

methods.name: phrase
methods.description: Getter/setter for the phrase component of the address.

methods.name: comment
methods.description: Getter/setter for comments associated with the address.

methods.name: set_or_get
methods.description: Internal method to set or retrieve components based on index.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats address components into a properly formatted email address string.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Extracts the person's name from the address components.

methods.name: host
methods.description: Retrieves the host/domain part of the email address.

methods.name: user
methods.description: Retrieves the user/local part of the email address.
